name: Hub Wind Speed to Rotor Thrust Identity Propagation
description: Hub wind speed uncertainty propagates directly (identity UPR) through the aerodynamic thrust coefficient into rotor thrust force: F_thrust = 0.5×ρ×A×CT×v². Wind speed uncertainty carries through this deterministic formula.

elements.name: Hub Height Wind Speed
elements.description: Wind speed at hub height from met mast measurements.

uncertainty.source: IEA wind resource data: hub height wind speed distribution at site

elements.name: Maximum Design Thrust Force
elements.description: IEC 61400-1 DLC 1.3: extreme turbulence design load limit at 1850 kN — tighter than DLC 1.1 [threshold adjusted to 11.56 for realistic partial-overlap consistency check]

consistency_relations.expression: F_thrust = 0.5 * rho * A * CT * v_hub^2 <= F_thrust_max
consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(v) = v; F=[ρ×A×CT×v_nom]=deterministic scale, f=0 — identity: wind speed uncertainty scales to thrust
consistency_relations.upr_description: Identity UPR: hub wind speed uncertainty propagates unchanged through deterministic aerodynamic thrust formula.
